reference_states.name: New request rejected with validation alert
reference_states.heading: New request

known_defects.description: Requests longer than the remaining balance are accepted.
known_defects.expected: A 13-day request on a 12-day balance is rejected with a validation message and no request is created.
known_defects.broken: The request is created and the remaining balance becomes -1.

known_defects.description: After a confirmed cancellation, the dashboard pending count does not decrease.
known_defects.expected: The request shows Cancelled and Pending requests goes from 1 to 0.
known_defects.broken: The request shows Cancelled, but Pending requests stays at 1.

known_defects.description: Saving an edit clears the reason.
known_defects.expected: A reason the user did not change is kept after Save changes.
known_defects.broken: The reason is empty after Save changes; the detail page shows None given.

known_defects.description: The email-updates toggle resets to off after a reload.
known_defects.expected: Display name, email and the toggle all show the saved values after a reload.
known_defects.broken: Name and email persist. The toggle shows on straight after Save, then off after a reload.

known_defects.description: Cancelled requests appear on the team calendar.
known_defects.expected: Only Pending and Approved requests are listed.
known_defects.broken: Cancelled requests are also listed, including the seeded one in a fresh workspace.
